info.title: TimeTracker V1 API
info.description: Session-cookie authentication; protected mutations require X-CSRF-Token. JSON endpoints use typed data/error/meta envelopes. CSV exports and metrics are explicit non-JSON exceptions.

get.description: Internal operational endpoint. Do not expose through the public ingress.

post.summary: Accept an invitation using its email link token

dayStartedAt.description: Entry start clipped to the requested day in the selected user's timezone.

dayEndedAt.description: Exclusive entry end clipped to the requested day; may be midnight of the following day.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Select a member by UUID, or use all for an Admin-only organization-wide list. Omit for your own entries.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Include entries overlapping this date in each selected member's timezone.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text search over task descriptions, project names, ticket references and titles, and tag names.

parameters.name: ticketId
parameters.description: Comma-separated UUIDs or repeated parameters; matches any selected ticket.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Comma-separated dimensions: member, project, ticket, tag, date.

get.description: Completed entries only; maximum 10,000 matching entries. Overall/detailed totals count each entry once. A multi-ticket entry contributes its duration to each linked ticket group.
